snapshot.description: Unmodified response from USA-NPN public getObservations API. Dataset ID 16, partner group NEON.

selection.rule: Select the three smallest individual_id values in this site/species/phase export, retain all their visits. The sample illustrates processing and does not estimate forest-wide phenology.

processing: Sort per individual by date. Select first recorded yes in the requested period and latest preceding no. Compute elapsed calendar days. Unknown status is not converted to no. Fail on duplicate dates or reported conflicts. Missing flag -9999 is not proof of a quality check. No interpolation or midpoint date.
